title: Science@Leuven Scholarship 2027-2028

organization.name: KU Leuven
organization.about: KU Leuven is a research university in Belgium with origins dating to 1425. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across science, engineering, medicine, humanities and social sciences. Its academic community connects teaching with research and international collaboration, supporting students and researchers pursuing questions across a broad range of disciplines.

deadlineText: Applications open 1 October 2026; both steps due 15 February 2027
intro: EUR 12000 per year scholarship for non-Belgian master’s students at KU Leuven Faculty of Science.
description: Science@Leuven Scholarship 2027-2028 offers EUR 12000 per year towards living expenses, renewable for up to two consecutive academic years subject to satisfactory first-year performance. Non-EEA students also receive a partial tuition fee waiver (the 2026-2027 reduced fee was EUR 3252.72; the 2027-2028 figure is not yet confirmed); EEA students receive the EUR 12000 allowance only. Open to all nationalities except Belgian nationals. Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree from a non-Belgian university qualifying them for the intended master’s, must not have previously studied or worked at KU Leuven, must not already hold a master’s or doctoral degree, must have a strong academic record at least equivalent to KU Leuven Distinction level, and must meet programme admission requirements including English proficiency (typically IELTS 7.0 overall with no band below 6.0-6.5, or TOEFL iBT 94 with minimum section scores). First submit a KU Leuven master’s programme application, then separately register for the Science@Leuven Scholarship uploading the confirmation email of the submitted master’s application. Both steps must be completed by 15 February 2027.
